title: Reflected XSS
impact: not so much, althouh it can be used for carefully constructed input, once you refresh it, it will disappear

title: Stored XSS
impact: An attacker can submit feedback containing malicious JavaScript that remains stored in the application. The script may execute whenever an administrator views the affected feedback
remediation: This flaw could expose active administrator sessions or enable an attacker to perform unauthorized actions on their behalf.
